# Create In-World Text

Source: [4345](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4345); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Create In-World Text](../../api/actions/create-in-world-text.md).

<a id="wiki-4345-n1"></a>

- In-world text persists until destroyed, exposes Last Text ID, and fails at text capacity.

<a id="wiki-4345-n2"></a>

- Player positions place text above their head; clipping controls visibility through walls, with reevaluation and spectator visibility configured separately.
